scope: Final amd64 production backend and voice images. Both have identical OS findings. Python metadata scans are not exhaustive inventories of wheel-vendored or statically linked native libraries.
coverage_warning: Scout omits advisories reported by Trivy and the official Debian tracker. Missing scanner findings are not evidence of a fix. No ignore files, VEX exclusions, severity overrides or ignore-unfixed filters were used.

trivy.count_unit: Unique CVE IDs; binary-package matches are repeated when one Debian source builds several installed packages. No findings were discarded during grouping.
